rounds.name: metabolic-coupling audit
rounds.target: Verify that resource contraction changes actual resident activity rather than only visual indicators.
rounds.method: Replayed the v0.2 160-second metabolism cycle for 10 cycles and measured resident-event frequency by metabolic state.
rounds.finding: The prototype changes resource labels, activity counters, and organ bars, but the resident event timer remains fixed at 12 seconds. LOW and DORMANT therefore do not truly lower metabolism; degradation is currently cosmetic at the event-loop layer.
rounds.constitutional_implication: Article-level graceful degradation must govern scheduling and work volume, not merely presentation state.
rounds.next_correction: Replace the fixed resident setInterval with a metabolism-aware scheduler: HIGH fastest, NORMAL baseline, LOW slower, DORMANT minimum heartbeat only. Then verify continuity across DORMANT -> LOW -> NORMAL recovery without visitor input.
